answer.reason: The verses tell of Shaphan receiving the found book of the law, reading it before the king, and going with the delegation to Huldah.

clauses.english: received the found book of the law from Hilkiah and read it before the king
clauses.quote: Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

clauses.english: was sent by the king with others to enquire of the LORD through Huldah the prophetess

doubts: JER 26:24, JER 29:3, JER 36:10-12 and the Gedaliah verses name Shaphan only as father or grandfather of others, so they were not used; the Gemariah of JER 36 is his son, not Shaphan himself.
2KI 22:3 and 2CH 34:8 (his being sent to repair the temple) were left out as that mission is partly covered by the summary's description as scribe.
